gloss: year by year; every year; with each passing year

definitions.gloss: year by year; every year; with each passing year
definitions.explanation: Indicates something that happens each year, or a gradual change that progresses with each passing year.

examples.japanese: {年毎|としごと}に{暑|あつ}くなっている。
examples.english: It gets hotter year by year.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}が{年毎|としごと}に{美|うつく}しく{咲|さ}く。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms bloom beautifully every year.

examples.japanese: {年毎|としごと}に{子供|こども}たちの{成長|せいちょう}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel the children's growth with each passing year.

notes:
Typically used with the particle に as {年毎|としごと}に. Part of a series of time-interval words using {毎|ごと}: {日毎|ひごと} (day by day), {月毎|つきごと} (month by month), {年毎|としごと} (year by year).

USAGE:
Used in two main patterns:
- {年毎|としごと}に + change: describes gradual change over years
- {年毎|としごと}の + noun: describes something that recurs annually

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年毎|としごと}に{増|ふ}える: to increase year by year
- {年毎|としごと}に{変|か}わる: to change year by year
- {年毎|としごと}の{行事|ぎょうじ}: annual event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毎年|まいとし}/{毎年|まいねん}: every year — simply states annual frequency, without the nuance of gradual change
- {年々|ねんねん}: year after year — very similar but more commonly used in written Japanese to describe progressive change
- {日毎|ひごと}に: day by day — the daily equivalent
